attempts.raw_response: The 56-year-old former minister was discovered at his home in the Flintshire constituency on Saturday evening. Police said there were no suspicious circumstances surrounding his death. Mr Sargeant had served as Minister for Social Justice and Local Government before his resignation, which came after allegations surfaced regarding his conduct toward women at various events. He had denied the claims through his solicitor. First Minister Jones expressed his sadness at the news, offering his condolences to Mr Sargeant's family. The Welsh Conservative leader said the circumstances were deeply tragic and urged people to wait for the facts to emerge. The inquiry into the First Minister's handling of the allegations was expected to report its findings in the coming weeks, with opposition parties calling for transparency throughout the process.

pair.human_continuation: Cerys Furlong, chief executive of the gender equality charity Chwarae Teg, called for the allegations against Mr Sargeant to be investigated "in a slightly different way". "I'm very mindful of the feelings and I can only imagine how those alleged victims feel at the moment," she said. "But I think given the circumstances we have to move forward in a slightly different way now." Wales' health secretary Vaughan Gething said he did not believe Mr Jones would resign as first minister following anger and criticism over the way he has handled Mr Sargeant's sacking as a Labour minister. There had been speculation the first minister would stand down but Mr Gething said: "No-one's asked me anything about Carwyn's future and I'm certainly not getting into any speculation.
pair.prefix: Mr Sargeant, the AM for Alyn and Deeside, was found dead four days after First Minister Carwyn Jones removed him from his post in the Welsh Government cabinet amid claims he had "touched or groped" a number of women. Mr Jones announced an inquiry looking into how he handled the allegations against Mr Sargeant and his subsequent actions. An inquest into Mr Sargeant's death is also due to be opened on Monday in Ruthin.
